relationships.subject: LIFU-activated BT-dNO@Gel bandage
relationships.evidence_quote: BT-dNO@Gel+LIFU concurrently downregulated lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and interferon-γ (IFN-γ)-induced M1-like macrophages while upregulating M2-like macrophages (Supplementary Fig. 18a, b)

relationships.subject: LIFU-activated BT-dNO@Gel bandage
relationships.evidence_quote: generate piezoelectric current to desensitize TRPV1 nociceptor for on demand neuropathic pain relief

relationships.subject: LIFU-activated BT-dNO@Gel bandage
relationships.evidence_quote: this regimen can promote CGRP neuropeptides release from sensory neurons to invigorate M2-like macrophages-mediated protective cutaneous immunity

key_findings: LIFU-activated piezoelectric gel bandage releases NO, generates piezoelectric current and ROS, promoting repair, antibacterial effects and M2-like macrophage polarization in diabetic wounds.
The regimen desensitizes TRPV1 nociceptors for pain relief and promotes CGRP release from sensory neurons supporting M2 macrophage immunity.
